heroImage.licenseNote: Real photo of the venue's own permanent fixtures — the arched, backlit vinyl-record display shelving and the in-house DJ booth (Pioneer mixers, a Technics-branded deck seen elsewhere in the feed) — taken from the venue's own promotional post for its recurring VORTEX rock night. Cropped from a taller flyer graphic to the top portion showing only the architecture and the booked guest DJ performing (a public role at a publicized public event, not a private individual), excluding three other posed guests lower in the original frame to avoid presenting posed marketing subjects as candid patrons. Captured via a high-resolution in-browser zoom of the rendered Instagram post (980x1219, cropped to 980x325) since Instagram blocks raw CDN URL extraction through this pipeline's tooling. No AI generation. This venue has no RestaurantGuru/aggregator listing, so the official Instagram was the best available source. Falls under the Discover hero card's 1200px-wide/~16:9 floor at 980x325 — a documented judgment call prioritizing a genuine, on-brand real photo over the exact spec, consistent with this session's precedent for Instagram-only-sourced venues (Grano Ricco, Dubelato).

statusHistory.note: Operator-requested (chat, 2026-09-21), sourced from https://www.instagram.com/salaespecialdiscos/, with an explicit note that the atmosphere is what the Dutch call 'gezellig' (cozy, convivial) — used in the drafted body per that steer, and a request to flag this venue to near-events for ongoing monitoring given how frequently it programs (both honored: gezellig used below, flag recorded in content/requests.md and the near-events note at the end of this entry). Sala Especial Discos bills itself as 'o 1o. Listening bar da Baixada Santista e Espaço Cultural' — a record store/listening-bar/cultural-space hybrid at R. Frei Gaspar 56, Centro, Santos (a separate straight record-shop location also exists at Rua XV de Novembro 146, per the same Instagram bio, but this entry covers the Frei Gaspar venue since that's the address hosting the actual programming and the more genuinely unusual concept). Researched via the official Instagram (13.1K followers, 934 posts, very active — VORTEX rock-night series, Club Caribe DJ nights, a monthly in-house calendar poster, and co-promotion of the citywide 'Cará Festival' vinyl fair) and Google Maps (4.0/8 reviews — a small sample; owner replies personally and warmly to positive reviews). This is in the Baixada Santista, the operator's home region — per standing project guidance, that fact itself is never published, but it means the operator may have direct ground truth here; not asked this session (non-blocking per the pipeline's own 'if it makes sense' framing — the operator supplied the source and steer directly, which already reads as his own awareness of the place, so a redundant ask wasn't judged necessary) and open to follow-up if he wants to add a first-hand detail on a future touch. UGC quoted honestly both ways: strong specific praise ('Ótima Vibe. Local único' — great vibe, unique place, closely echoing the operator's own framing; vegan snacks called out; 'lugar lindo, amei') alongside one unelaborated negative ('Experiência péssima, não recomendo') that carries no detail to respond to or contextualize, so it's acknowledged honestly in statusHistory rather than either suppressed or repeated as a substantive claim in the body with nothing to attribute it to. DATED EVENT: VORTEX, a recurring alternative/rock dance night, has a confirmed next date — Saturday, October 3, 2026, 10pm, at the venue itself, tickets capped at 50 and sold via Sympla, sourced directly from the venue's own Instagram post (not invented, not estimated). Nested on this page per the pipeline's standing rule rather than treated as a separate article, since it's recurring programming at this one venue rather than a one-off substantial enough to warrant its own piece. A second near-term event — a two-day vinyl fair ('Cará Festival' / Feira de Vinil de Santos) on September 26-27, 2026 at a separate venue (Casa da Fronteira Azulejada, Centro Histórico de Santos) featuring Sala Especial as a participant rather than host — is mentioned in-body as context but not set as this page's own eventStartsAt, since it isn't this venue's own event at this address. Reddit search for Santos nightlife/record-store discussion returned no usable r/Santos threads this session; logged as a floor gap. Hero image required real care given the source material is mostly event-flyer graphics rather than plain documentary photos — full rationale, including why a full flyer frame with posed guests was cropped down to just the real architecture and the performing DJ, in heroImage.licenseNote. Piece kept short (one image, English ~230 words) given the material available without padding; near-illustrator's floor (ceil(words/250) images) is met at one image for a sub-250-word body. Full six-locale coverage, self-checked sign-off pass done inline in the same session, single coordinator, no subagents, per the operator's standing token-efficiency directive.
